capabilities: Sorts explorer names by numeral value
Recognizes Chinese, Arabic and Roman numerals
Resolves ambiguous numeral patterns per folder
Re-sorts on command or ribbon click
extras: Zero configuration; only takes over alphabetical sorting and steps aside for Modified/Created time sorts. Includes a diagnose command that prints folder order to the console.
intentEvidence: This plugin replaces the explorer's own sort routine so numbers — Arabic, Chinese and Roman alike — are compared by value
problem: Obsidian's file explorer orders items by Unicode code points, so Chinese numeral names like 第一章, 第二章, 第十章 come out shuffled.
summary: Natural-sort plugin that makes Obsidian's file explorer order Chinese, Arabic and Roman numerals by value instead of Unicode code points.
